set.body:
Goal: interpret START/END and associated configuration without assuming one global sample layout.

Acceptance criteria:
- A pure Machine tracks recording blocks, selected eyes, event/sample modes, coordinate mode, prescalers, optional columns, remote-mode fields, rate evidence, and configuration changes.
- Samples or events before a sufficient configuration produce named requirements rather than guessed layouts.
- Multiple blocks may use different layouts without state leakage.
- START/END pairing, truncation, nested starts, duplicate configuration, and unexpected end records have explicit outcomes.
- Whole-line execution and arbitrary line chunking are observationally equal, including flush behavior.
- Tests cover monocular left, monocular right, binocular, samples-only, events-only, and combined blocks.
set.title: Implement the EyeLink recording-block configuration state machine
